answer: An operator leases one numbered cabin at Yarrow Junction, where three running lines meet in a surveyed delta. Only that holder may seat a uniquely serialled lever collar and, in a published timetable window, pull a one-shot route so the official track-circuit signal and detector-bar film must match the collar stamp and the cabin lease. Graders match collar, film, and block log. A shared cabin, a reused collar, or an off-window pull is slashed as one farm. Fielding N aliases costs N exclusive cabins, N unique collars, and N live timetable pulls no single signalman can staff at once.
